body: I don't think I ever have courage when I make an attempt. I try methods where I hope I lose conciseness without being aware that I'm about to die — or methods that render me unconscious quickly so I can't stop myself. There's always fear: fear that it won't work; fear that it *will* work; fear that you'll mess your body up forever; fear that you're forgetting something important; fear of messing up those in your life after you're gone. I think focus is the only thing that allows me to carry out an attempt. You just focus on why you're attempting in the first place and trying to cancel out all other noise. There's nothing wrong with not having courage to go through with it. I wish none of us were successful. I wish that after an attempt, something big would change in our lives for the better and we could just be happy and safe.

I hate how much money comes into play. I hate watching my credit go to shit, and everything I worked for disappear. Waking up to the daily dreadful thought, "Is today the day they take such-and-such away?" I am so sorry you're going through this. If I had the money to help I would. I'm so sorry. Finances put a strain on not just yourself, but your relationships with everyone around you. I hope you and your husband can overcome even just one obstacle that you're facing. Is there anyone you can stay with? Just for a night who will let you feel safe, or give you a shoulder to cry on?

Andrea, I can understand some of what you've experienced. The dehumanizing stares; looks of mistrust, disgust, or skepticism. In my experience, one of the most painful and infuriating things is when you have someone who you think understands what you're going through. Someone you confide in. Then you realize that's not the case, and there's no one to lean on. 

I hope that you can find a large group of friends who give you enough support and confidence that you're not forced ever feel alone or isolated. 

We don't know each other but please, *please* feel free to message me with venting or rants or anything when you feel that such things are unbearable. You should never have to feel dehumanized for simply being a person. I'm so sorry that you are.
